independence: Single model. Five path-A and five path-B subagent contexts. Each context received every question in one prompt, so questions inside a round can leak. Rounds did not see each other's SQL, tool calls, or answers. Temperature is not controllable, so identical prompts may still yield identical answers. Not a live MCP HTTP session: path B is GraneKernel.query, which is what the MCP query tool calls. No API keys or tokens.
